caveats: Texture-specific independent evidence is very thin. No blind benchmark exists for tileable PBR material generators or for skybox/panorama generators. The only benchmarks (top3d.ai Textured board, 3D Arena render board) judge whole textured 3D models, so mesh quality leaks into the scores. Rodin's split (#2 textured vs #14 geometry) is the clearest texture-specific signal. Most texture 'comparisons' are vendor-authored (Meshy, Tripo, Hyper3D, 3D AI Studio, image-to-3d.ai, PLAYTEX, Lovart, Cinevva, Sloyd, StraySpark) and were excluded. Coruzant is the only multi-tool same-prompt review with texture verdicts, and its independence is unclear. Review-site ratings (Trustpilot) are whole-product and rarely mention textures. Reddit and X were not sampled by design. Forum searches (Polycount, Blender Artists, Unity Discussions, Hacker News) found no recent threads on output quality, so community sampling is 0 for every tool. No Sketchfab or YouTube examples were collected. Percentile scores use 100*(N-rank)/(N-1).
